collection_path.label: Collection path
collection_path.description: Path to collection.anki2 or its profile folder. Leave empty to use the only Anki profile under ~/.local/share/Anki2.

refresh_seconds.label: Refresh interval
refresh_seconds.description: Seconds between checks, 600 by default. Cards due later still become due between checks.

follow_accent.label: Follow accent colors
follow_accent.description: Tints the Anki icon, number, and fill from the palette. Off uses Anki blue.

include_new.label: Include new cards
include_new.description: Counts every new card. Anki deck limits are not applied, so this is an upper bound.

sync_enabled.label: Sync with AnkiWeb
sync_enabled.description: Sync the local collection before each check. Needs an AnkiWeb sync key and network access.

sync_key.label: AnkiWeb sync key
sync_key.description: Private sync key used only when sync is enabled. Stored in Noctalia settings.

sync_key_file.label: AnkiWeb sync key file
sync_key_file.description: Read the key from this file instead of the setting above. Useful with sops-managed secrets.

error.stream: Could not start the Anki helper
error.stale: No recent update from the Anki helper
